limitations: Diagnostic analysis of one external dataset; associations are descriptive.
Rule-type and construct classifications are read from code and the adapter mapping.

construct_validity.measures_satsa_concept: partly: SAT-SA treats unusually fast closure of security alerts as a possible skipped investigation; in IT service management fast resolution is the service goal
no: state changes are not investigation steps; ITSM tickets often resolve directly from New
no: reassignment routes work, it is not a severity escalation
only as valid as the underlying proxy metrics
construct_validity.source: groups of one organisation compared on the metrics above

construct_validity.measures_satsa_concept: no: timeliness against a service target, not supervisory execution quality

design.note: diagnostic only; no tuning on the evaluation data

anomaly.closure_time.high.rule_type: distribution (> 3 MAD within the entity; capped at 20)

anomaly.investigation_depth.high.rule_type: distribution (> 3 MAD within the entity; capped at 20)

anomaly.investigation_duration.high.rule_type: distribution (> 3 MAD within the entity; capped at 20)

case_similarity.template_cluster.rule_type: existence (any cluster of >= 2 near-identical step sequences)

execution_gap.ack_without_investigation.rule_type: existence (any medium+ alert whose case has < 2 steps)

execution_gap.fast_closure.rule_type: existence (any alert closed faster than its severity limit, >= 30 s)

execution_gap.potential_metric_gaming.rule_type: rate (critical/high closure rate >= 90% with <= 1.5 average steps)

execution_gap.repeated_investigation_pat.rule_type: rate or note-length rule (dominant step pair >= 60% of pairs, or median note < 30 chars; the source has no notes, so the adapter's empty notes always satisfy it)

peer_benchmark.critical_closure_median_s.rule_type: cohort (> 2 MAD from peer median, >= 3 peers)

peer_benchmark.escalation_rate.deviation.rule_type: cohort (> 2 MAD from peer median, >= 3 peers)

peer_benchmark.investigation_depth_media.rule_type: cohort (> 2 MAD from peer median, >= 3 peers)

workflow_reconstruction.sequence_chronol.rule_type: existence (any case whose step sequence disagrees with timestamps)

notes: made_sla is read only from the final event; SAT-SA never receives it
risk and label are computed over the same incidents and the same period
